t: How the servants of the Merciful are described
a: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
p: Wa ʿibādu-r-Raḥmāni-lladhīna yamshūna ʿala-l-arḍi hawnan wa idhā khāṭabahumu-l-jāhilūna qālū salāmā.
m: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
